questions.q: How does a dashboard filter differ from a report filter?
options: A dashboard filter is baked in and applies to everyone the same way
A dashboard filter is interactive and lets a viewer narrow what they see at that moment, without changing the underlying reports
Dashboard filters require edit access to use
There is no difference; they behave identically
questions.explain: Dashboard filters sit on top of the dashboard and are viewer-facing and interactive, resetting each time a viewer leaves. Report filters are baked into the report itself and apply every time it runs, for everyone.

questions.q: How many filters can be added to a single dashboard?
options: Only one
Up to three
Up to ten
An unlimited number
questions.explain: Up to three filters can be added to a dashboard through + Filter in the Dashboard Builder, each becoming a dropdown viewers can use.

questions.q: What access level does a viewer need to use a dashboard filter?
options: Manager access to the folder
Editor access to the dashboard
No special access beyond being able to view the dashboard already
System Administrator profile
questions.explain: Using a filter is a viewing-time convenience, not a configuration change — anyone who can already see the dashboard can use its filters without needing edit rights.

questions.q: What actually controls who is allowed to open a given dashboard?
options: The dashboard filters that have been configured
The folder the dashboard is saved in, and how that folder is shared
Whichever chart types are used on the dashboard
The running user setting alone
questions.explain: Dashboard access follows the same folder-sharing model as reports. Filters only affect what a viewer sees within the access they already have — they don't grant or restrict who can open the dashboard.

questions.q: A VP wants regional managers to see the same company-wide dashboard, each narrowed to their own region, without building a separate dashboard per region. What feature solves this?
options: A dashboard filter on the region field
Creating a new custom report type for each region
Changing the folder's sharing to Manager for every regional manager
Converting the dashboard into a Joined report
questions.explain: A dashboard filter on the region field lets each viewer narrow the same dashboard to their own region interactively, with no need to duplicate the dashboard or touch folder sharing.
